name: Planify Quick View
description: Adds a Planify button to the GNOME top bar. Clicking it opens a quick-view card with your due-today and overdue tasks; click a task to complete it, click outside or press Escape to dismiss. Tasks come live from the Planify app over D-Bus (no database access), and completion is delegated to the app so recurring tasks and sync stay consistent. Start Planify to see your tasks.
